messages:
tess: Quick planning thread for the PLG funnel experiment. Idea: combine a short launch post series with a single-track webinar. Test credit allocation: 100 immediate vs 100 + 300 attendance bonus. Also test two prompt packs: starter vs deep. Goal = bump 7-day active dev rate by 8-12%.

omar: Keep launch post technical and pragmatic. Hero: small video of a live build. CTA variants: "Try with credits" / "Register for the demo".

leo: Routing: inbound -> signup page shows immediate credits and pack. If RSVP & attends -> unlock bonus. Use webhook to unlock 300. Tag cohort in profile.

maya: I'll own copy and email flows. Two email variants: credits-first and webinar-first. Follow-up for no-shows: recording + 50 credits.

ops-bot: Calendar and registration page created: https://events.redwood.ai/starter-deep?utm=starter_deep_launch. Reminder cadence set: -24h, -1h, +10m.

tess: Measurement: track click -> signup -> rsvp -> attend -> claim -> first_api_call. Key metric: first_api_call <= 48h.

omar: Include a small benchmark card on the landing page: sample p50 latency + sample token cost for starter vs deep packs. Keep it simple.

leo: Config snippet for devex: 
```
experiment: starter_deep_launch_2026
arms: [instant100, attendance400]
templates: [starter, deep]
cohort_split: 50_50
```

maya: Timeline: assets by Thu, page live Mon, webinar Tue 10am PT. Owners assigned. Next sync Friday.

tess: Thanks team. Moving to execution.
